title: Owner: Update now during a foreground nerv launch is refused with the foreground reason
goal: NERV-01 is updated through the service, and once the fix is installed a foreground launch is refused with its pid
acceptance: After the fix is installed, Update now during a foreground nerv launch is refused with the foreground reason and its pid; then stopping the launch and starting the service lets an update run
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: Owner-observed check: git -C ~/.nerv-app rev-parse --short HEAD and the updater.log outcome
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: four copy-paste steps and one update. Not a measurement. 2026-11-26: the completed-update half moved to B-122-T03 (agent, read-only), owner-step triage.
